ideas.name: any warning the session before a holiday
ideas.why: before a market holiday desks are thin and flat: no one carries a move, so turns pay

ideas.name: any warning on a release day
ideas.why: a red-folder release (CPI, NFP, FOMC ...) that day gives the market information to reprice on; it trends, so turns fail

ideas.name: any warning in the first hour against yesterday's last hour
ideas.why: the last hour's flow (closing imbalances, funds squaring) often reverses overnight and into the open; a morning turn against it is that unwinding

ideas.name: any warning on a Monday morning
ideas.why: Monday's first two hours price the weekend's news: directional repricing, so turns fail
